description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Gruul Turf
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
